provenance.outline: RECORDED - US Census cartographic boundary via us-atlas 3.0.1 counties-10m (1:10m, coarse, coastline-clipped); vendored in parishes/vendor/us-atlas, sha-checked
provenance.frame: DERIVED - bounding box of the RECORDED Bay campus + anchor points in geo/registry/campuses_geo.json and the recorded restoration site points in restoration/registry/restoration.json
provenance.selection: DERIVED - computed by intersecting RECORDED outlines with the DERIVED Bay frame
provenance.adjacency: DERIVED - two counties connect when their outlines share a TopoJSON arc
provenance.area: DERIVED - planar area of the coarse outline in the county LOCAL frame
provenance.districts: AUTHORED - procedural district seeds of the map fabric; NOT official neighbourhoods
provenance.campuses: as tagged in geo/registry/campuses_geo.json (oakland RECORDED, treasure-island DERIVED) - copied, never upgraded
provenance.anchors: RECORDED - city points in geo/registry/campuses_geo.json (Locator.X CITIES, Apache-2.0)
provenance.maps: DERIVED outline + AUTHORED fabric; not imagery, not a survey
provenance.water_labels: AUTHORED - approximate label points for general geography only

source.data_origin: U.S. Census Bureau cartographic boundary files, 2017, 1:10,000,000 (public domain, work of the U.S. federal government), as packaged by us-atlas

bay_frame.provenance: DERIVED - bounding box of the RECORDED Bay campus + anchor points in geo/registry/campuses_geo.json and the recorded restoration site points in restoration/registry/restoration.json

selection.rule: every California county (state FIPS 06) whose RECORDED outline intersects the DERIVED Bay frame (any vertex inside, any frame corner inside, or any edge crossing)
selection.provenance: DERIVED - computed by intersecting RECORDED outlines with the DERIVED Bay frame

wider_frame.why_not_used: it reaches the Central Valley and Sierra foothills; the Bay frame from the campus points is the honest Bay extent

frames.ltp_formula: equirectangular local tangent plane about an origin (lat0, lng0): east_m = R * cos(radians(lat0)) * radians(lng - lng0); north_m = R * radians(lat - lat0); inverse: lat = lat0 + degrees(north_m / R); lng = lng0 + degrees(east_m / (R * cos(radians(lat0)))); R = 6371008.8 m (IUGG mean radius, the R of geo3d/build.py). Scene convention (geo3d): x = east_m, z = -north_m, y up. Distortion grows with distance from the origin: the east-west scale error at a point is cos(lat)/cos(lat0) - 1, computed per parish as frame.max_ew_scale_error_pct (north-south scale is exact on the sphere).

world.what: one shared metre frame for every county; world_m = [east_m, north_m]

frames.local: per county: origin = counties[fips].frame.origin; local_m = [east_m, north_m]

water.statement: The Census cartographic outline is clipped to the COASTLINE: San Francisco Bay, San Pablo Bay and the Pacific lie OUTSIDE every land outline and are drawn as open water. Smaller inland water (reservoirs, sloughs, parts of the delta) is NOT cut out at 1:10m and lies inside outlines; area_km2 includes it.

labels.name: San Francisco Bay
labels.note: approximate label point, AUTHORED; the bay itself is outside every land outline (open water)

elevation: no real elevation: the Bay hills are not modelled; the ground is flat AUTHORED at 0 m
districts_rule: AUTHORED procedural district (Voronoi seed of the map fabric) - NOT an official neighbourhood. Locator.X (/home/user/locator.x, Apache-2.0 code, CC BY 4.0 docs) was checked: its data/ tree is not committed (data/README.md), so it offers no local district data; no official neighbourhood list is used or claimed.
city_note: no city boundary is held (us-atlas has counties only): San Francisco city = San Francisco County (consolidated city-county); Oakland lies in Alameda County but its city limits are not held, so Alameda districts are AUTHORED county districts, tagged by distance to the RECORDED Oakland point
landmarks_rule: none authored in this pack (landmarks: [] everywhere); only campus points and RECORDED city points are pinned

campuses_not_placed.name: San Francisco campus (treasure-island)
campuses_not_placed.why: point lies in 0 selected coarse outlines (small islands are not in the 1:10m outline); kept in registry.campuses_not_placed

restoration_rule: every site in restoration/registry/restoration.json with a recorded lat/lng is inside the Bay frame by construction (its point widens the frame); placed in the county whose coarse outline holds it, else kept in restoration_not_placed at its recorded world_m

restoration_not_placed.name: San Francisco Estuary Invasive Spartina Removal
restoration_not_placed.why: the restoration registry records no single point (lat/lng null) - not placed, never guessed

restoration_not_placed.name: Former Naval Station Treasure Island (NSTI) — Navy BRAC cleanup site (Treasure Island)
restoration_not_placed.why: point lies in 0 selected coarse outlines (open water or an island absent at 1:10m): kept at its recorded world_m, not moved onto land

not_placed.name: San Francisco campus (treasure-island)
not_placed.why: point lies in 0 selected coarse outlines (small islands are not in the 1:10m outline); kept in registry.campuses_not_placed

not_placed.name: Sausalito
not_placed.why: point lies in 0 selected outlines (dropped, not moved)

fetches: none - every input is a local file listed in inputs
landmarks_method: no landmark is authored in the bayarea pack; pins are the geo registry campus points (as tagged) and RECORDED Locator.X city points only
borders_note: shared borders are DERIVED from shared TopoJSON arcs of the coarse 1:10m outlines; whether a border runs over land or water is NOT recorded. By its coordinates the short 06001|06075 arc (about 0.4 km) lies in the open bay on the Bay Bridge corridor: treat it as a water crossing (AUTHORED note), not a road. Marin has no selected neighbour: the Golden Gate is open water between outlines, so Marin joins the world by water only.

satellite.rule: view-time only, in the learner's browser; never fetched, stored or baked by any build; the 4k maps contain no imagery

usgs.licence: public domain (work of the U.S. federal government)
usgs.when_unavailable: fall back to the drawn 4k map; say "USGS imagery did not answer"

mapbox.refusal_text: Mapbox satellite: off - no token configured
mapbox.rule: same deploy-time pk. token rule as parishes/registry/parishes.json#satellite.mapbox

natural_earth.licence: public domain - see NATURAL_EARTH_LICENSE.md, vendored beside this
natural_earth.clip: oakland (the vendored clip around the Oakland campus; the Treasure Island clip is the same window)
natural_earth.provenance: RECORDED at Natural Earth 1:10m scale (coarse - a generalised shoreline, not a survey); world_m = [east_m, north_m]
natural_earth.use: the bays/ocean are already open water outside the Census outlines; this NE line is the RECORDED coarse shoreline DEEP/RESTORE may draw or test against

streets.note: AUTHORED street polylines - the same procedural fabric the maps draw, NOT the real street grid; local metres [east_m, north_m] in the parish frame, rounded to 1 m
streets.inside_rule: every vertex lies inside the RECORDED coarse outline (checked, even-odd); INLAND water is NOT cut out at 1:10m, so some polylines lie over Lake Pontchartrain / Lake Maurepas / the river exactly where the maps draw fabric over them - treat water.labels areas as water, not road

corners_world_m.note: the map is square in its LOCAL frame; place by these world corners

districts_map.label: AUTHORED districts (procedural Voronoi cells) - NOT official neighbourhoods
districts_map.georeference: same square, extent and pixel rule as map (extent_local_m, m_per_px)
districts_map.cells: nearest district seed among this county's districts, land pixels only, computed at 1024 px and scaled x4
districts_map.provenance: AUTHORED districts over the DERIVED map

06097.districts_note: AUTHORED procedural district (Voronoi seed of the map fabric) - NOT an official neighbourhood
